$doc: SHARD-PLATFORM SF46 (G164): Driftwood's four midpoint entries walked edge -> shard and back with the hybrid row ON (the whole world lowered 0.8 m, the sea at road height). Each inward leg starts 1 m inside the edge midpoint on the platform's 8 x 15 m socket floor (y 0, socketOverWater), crosses the declared plank landing 15 m in, climbs the pier / jetty's sea-end ramp and walks the deck onto dry ground; each outward leg walks the deck back down the ramp onto the landing and the socket to the edge (the jetties' island ends are steps down, never walk-ups, so the north / east legs start on their decks). The last leg steps off the pier deck between the pilings onto the moored boat (E308, z -203). Run: scripts/browser-lane.sh node scripts/physics-baseline.mjs --no-build --mode=walk --shard=driftwood-isle --route=progress/shard-platform/sf46/entries-route.json --device-save=debug.plugin.driftwood-isle.driftwoodHybrid=on --url=<served build>

driftwood-isle.name: south in
driftwood-isle.notes: socket -> landing -> pier ramp -> deck -> beach landing -> dry sand

driftwood-isle.name: south out
driftwood-isle.notes: along the pier deck, down its sea-end ramp onto the landing and the socket (its island end drops 2.1 m to the shallows, never a walk-up, as ever)

driftwood-isle.name: north in
driftwood-isle.notes: jetty ends 60 m in over 0.5 m sand

driftwood-isle.name: north out
driftwood-isle.notes: along the jetty deck, down its sea-end ramp onto the landing and the socket (its island end is a 0.7 m step up, never a walk-up)

driftwood-isle.name: west in
driftwood-isle.notes: the jetty deck runs into the rising sand ~88 m in

driftwood-isle.name: east in
driftwood-isle.notes: jetty ends 72 m in, a 1.1 m step down to the cove's wet sand

driftwood-isle.name: east out
driftwood-isle.notes: along the jetty deck, down its sea-end ramp onto the landing and the socket (its island end is a 1.1 m step up)

driftwood-isle.name: pier to boat
driftwood-isle.notes: G164: the boat moored by the pier again (E308, z -203), lowered with the world: off the deck between the pilings, 0.88 m down over the gunwale onto the boat floor
